provenance: Community references and game-extracted database; console build not independently verified. Live evidence overrides predictions.

rules.statement: Use current named cards, costs, intents, inventory and counters. Unknown fields stay unknown; re-observe after a material change.
Corruption makes Skills cost zero and exhaust when played. Powers retain their current cost.
In a long fight, inspect hand and draw pile and compare Barricade setup before Corruption. Corruption does not immediately exhaust retained Skills.
rules.conditions: Runic Pyramid confirmed, Barricade not active; evaluate energy, incoming damage and skill reserve. This is not a mandatory card order.

rules.statement: Headbutt returns a card from discard to the top of draw. Confirm an eligible discard target; a sorted pile listing does not prove draw order.
True Grit exhausts a random other hand card; True Grit+ chooses. Verify upgrade and remaining hand before choosing an exhaust.
Before End Turn review all playable zero-cost cards, damage, safety and card-count limits. Body Slam uses current Block plus applicable attack modifiers.
Review confirmed potions before spending HP or ending a dangerous turn. Record observed consumption immediately; Fairy in a Bottle triggers automatically.
Every twelfth played card resolves then ends the player turn; Time Eater gains 2 Strength. Counter persists across ordinary turns. Potions do not count.
Once per fight, going strictly below half HP queues Haste for the following turn. It heals to half HP and removes debuffs; current intent still resolves.
Displayed intent already includes visible damage modifiers. Do not multiply it by Vulnerable again. Recompute from verified raw per-hit values only when modifiers change.
Eternal Feather heals 3 per 5 deck cards on rest-site entry; Pantograph heals 25 at boss start. Do not count entry healing twice. Compare Rest with Smith.

variants.next_high_threat: First Hyper Beam on enemy action 6; base damage plus current Strength. Two unmodified Boosts make 51 below A4 or 58 at A4+.

behavior: After the opening, repeat Flail, Boost, Flail, Boost, Hyper Beam, then Stunned (A0–18) or Boost (A19+).

Strength applies to each hit. Orbs attack for base 8, give Automaton 12 Block or use Stasis once to capture an eligible highest-rarity draw card (discard if draw empty); killing an Orb returns its card. Do not predict a specific stolen card.
Source conflict: use A4 Boost Strength upgrade from boss table and extracted statistics, not standalone Strength wiki A9 claim.

behavior: Reverberate is three hits; at most twice consecutively. Head Slam and Ripple cannot repeat consecutively.
Head Slam reduces next-turn draw by one; A19+ adds two Slimed to discard. Ripple gains 20 Block, applies one Weak and Vulnerable, plus Frail at A19+.
Haste is strictly below half HP, once per fight, on the following turn; it does not interrupt current intent. Heals to half and removes debuffs.
Time Warp counts cards, including zero-cost cards and Powers, but not potions. The twelfth resolves, then ends the turn and adds 2 Strength before an ensuing attack.
